claude-subscription-directsdk-experiment.note: Vendored verbatim from the plugin directory at revision (the standalone hermes-plugin-claude-subscription-directsdk repo moved here on 2026-10-10). Baked in as a bundled provider. Claude Code 2.1.299 is the CLI the plugin's README re-checked on Max (Oct 14-15 2026) and is past the 2.1.293 that the haiku alias needs.
